store.description: TrailMate brings offline TMAP maps, route viewing and navigation, track recording, geocaching and LoRa messaging to Cardputer Zero. With a Cap LoRa-1262 module, it supports Meshtastic, MeshCore and Reticulum, node discovery, broadcasts, private chats, delivery status and GNSS satellite reception. Incoming messages update in real time. Optional private-message auto-replies activate only while the screen is asleep. Online map creation supports worldwide administrative-area search, area and layer selection, progress and cancellation. The keyboard interface includes directional focus, Fn+H help, Ctrl+Enter to send in Chat, widget screens and long Home/Escape to return to APPLaunch. Music, agenda, calculator and route photos are also included. LoRa and GNSS require the external Cap; online map creation requires an internet connection. Installable package and device acceptance: https://github.com/vicliu624/trail-mate/releases/tag/v1.1.0 . Physical-device demo: https://youtu.be/eBIRhOy7cJc
